summary: FS Credit Opportunities Corp. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 disclosing the adjournment of its reconvened Annual Meeting. The August 3, 2026 meeting elected Walter W. Buckley, III as a Class I Director, but the election of Barbara J. Fouss could not proceed because a quorum of preferred stockholders was absent. Meetings reconvened September 8 and September 24, 2026 were similarly adjourned for lack of preferred quorum. The meeting is rescheduled for October 6, 2026 in Philadelphia. No deal, stake, price, or advisor terms are stated; this is a routine governance scheduling matter, not a special situation.
